name: Synology
description: Shows a Synology NAS (DiskStation Manager 7) as a host with its Container Manager containers, Virtual Machine Manager machines and installed packages as guests, matched to your network devices by IP or MAC. Read-only, over the DSM web API with HTTPS; needs a dedicated administrator account (DSM has no read-only API role). Tested against a simulated DSM only; a real DS923+ test is pending.
author: Netlens
supports: Synology DSM 7.2 (not tested on hardware yet)

releases.changelog: First release. Containers, virtual machines and packages of a Synology NAS as guests of the NAS. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
